article.title: Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks
article.summary: A critical authentication bypass allows attackers to execute arbitrary code as admin and take over XCP-ng nodes. The post Critical Xen Orchestra Flaws Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Các lỗ hổng nghiêm trọng trong Xen Orchestra đang bị khai thác thực tế, cho phép kẻ tấn công thực thi mã từ xa với quyền admin và chiếm quyền kiểm soát các nút XCP-ng.

article.title: Git fixes six vulnerabilities, including code execution during recursive clones
article.summary: The Git project has released security updates addressing six vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute code, write to unintended files or cause memory corruption when Git processes malicious repositories or other specially prepared input. Code execution during cloning A vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-111760 stems from an integer truncation in Git’s handling of its index. items.relevance_reason: Dự án Git đã phát hành các bản cập nhật khắc phục 6 lỗ hổng bảo mật, bao gồm rủi ro thực thi mã nguy hiểm khi thực hiện lệnh clone đệ quy các kho lưu trữ.

article.title: Fortinet Patches Nearly 100 Vulnerabilities
article.summary: The massive drop comes after the company integrated frontier AI models into its product security testing. The post Fortinet Patches Nearly 100 Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Fortinet phát hành đợt cập nhật quy mô lớn để vá gần 100 lỗ hổng bảo mật sau khi áp dụng các mô hình AI tiên tiến vào quy trình kiểm thử sản phẩm.

article.title: Over 35,000 Grok-Built Apps Exposed Online, Some Leaking Confidential Data and Passwords
article.summary: Of the 37,571 Grok-built apps that security company Claroc found online, 35,578 were open to anyone without a sign-in, the researchers said yesterday. They included 24 apps built by staff at the social network X and at SpaceXSI, the company that makes the Grok AI assistant.
